Name: Potluck
Author: FinFNS
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🍲 Potluck[/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[size=5]Potluck is a modular Vanilla+ [/size][/center]
[center][size=5]MO2 Wabbajack mod list for Stardew Valley.[/size][/center]

[size=4]The goal is to expand Stardew Valley with more content, variety, quality-of-life improvements, and customization while preserving the charm and identity of the original game.[/size]
[size=4]
Potluck handles the tedious part of assembling and organizing a large mod setup so you can spend more time actually playing it.[/size]

[line]

[heading]What Does Potluck Add?[/heading]
[size=4]Potluck brings together mods covering areas such as:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=4]New and expanded gameplay[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Major System Overhauls[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]New NPCs, dialogue, and game events[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]New content[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Quality-of-life improvements[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Visual and Performance improvements[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]User interface improvements[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Immersion[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]The included mods are organized and tested together rather than simply being thrown into one giant Mods folder.[/size]
[line]
[heading]🧰 Mod Organizer 2[/heading]
[size=4]Potluck uses [b]Mod Organizer 2[/b] and is distributed through [b]Wabbajack[/b].
MO2 keeps the list organized and makes it considerably easier to maintain, troubleshoot, and customize.
You do [b]not[/b] need to install your own copy of MO2 or SMAPI. Everything required by Potluck is provided with the Wabbajack installation.[/size]
[line]
[heading]🧪 Modular by Design[/heading]
[size=4]The MO2 Mod List includes a tested default profile (called Potluck) that is intended to provide a ready-to-play experience.[/size]
[size=4]
Many included mods can also be enabled or disabled if you want to build your own MO2 Profile of the mod list.[/size]
[size=4]
MO2 Notes provide useful information about individual mods, including known requirements, incompatibilities, and configuration details.[/size]
[size=4]
Potluck also includes a [b]Compatibility Checker[/b] to help identify known problems with your selected combination of mods.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Customization[/heading]
[size=4]The default Potluck MO2 Profile is the configuration primarily tested and supported.
If you want to customize the list, create your own MO2 Profile and experiment there. You can also add your own mods, although off-list additions are naturally outside the tested Potluck configuration.
Potluck provides the starting point. What you put on your plate is up to you.[/size]
[line]
[heading]
⚠️ Clean Installation Required[/heading]
[size=4]Potluck should be installed against a [b]clean Steam installation of Stardew Valley on Windows 10 or 11[/b].[/size]
[size=4]
Existing Vortex mods, manually installed mods, old SMAPI installations, and mods remaining in the game directory or AppData can interfere with Potluck.[/size]
[size=4]
Please follow the Installation Guide before installing.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Updating[/heading]
[size=4]Potluck updates are installed through Wabbajack.
Always read the revision notes before updating, particularly when continuing an existing save.[/size]
[size=4]Backing up your saves before updating is strongly recommended.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Support[/heading]
[size=4]Support, discussion, update announcements, and troubleshooting are available through the [b]Smorgasbord Discord community:[/b]  [url=https://discord.gg/Ay2pVZHE7S]https://discord.gg/Ay2pVZHE7S[/url][/size]
[size=4]
When requesting help, please provide your SMAPI log and mention whether the problem also occurs using the unchanged Potluck default profile.[/size]
[line]
[heading]Credits[/heading]
[size=4]Potluck is created and maintained by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/FinFNS]FinFNS[/url][/b], but the list would not exist without the work of the many Stardew Valley mod authors whose creations make it possible.[/size]
[size=4]
[b]All credit for individual mods belongs to their respective authors.[/b][/size]
[size=4]
Please visit their mod pages, endorse their work, read their documentation, and report mod-specific issues appropriately.[/size]
[size=4]
Special thanks to the developers and contributors behind [b]Stardew Valley, SMAPI, Mod Organizer 2, Wabbajack, Nexus Mods[/b], and the wider Stardew Valley modding community.[/size]

[line]
[size=4]Everyone brings something to a potluck.
We've brought the mods.
[b]You decide what goes on your plate.[/b][/size]
